in_scope.item: Error responses for duplicate, expired, and missing-field cases

milestones.scope: POST /payment/v1/cards — save, dedup, expiry validation, tokenisation
Token refresh and card deletion (separate RFC)

validation_sequence.name: Feature flag gate
validation_sequence.constraint: flag must be enabled for the environment
validation_sequence.failure_condition: flag disabled → HTTP 404 Not Found (no response body specified in RFC)
validation_sequence.notes: On/off behaviour is enumerated in feature_flags[]; 404 has no named error code or body.

validation_sequence.name: Required fields present
validation_sequence.what_is_validated: cardNumber, expiryMonth, expiryYear, cvv all present
validation_sequence.failure_condition: any required field absent; body reports the first missing field

validation_sequence.name: Card number format
validation_sequence.what_is_validated: cardNumber is 13-19 digits and passes Luhn
validation_sequence.failure_condition: cardNumber not 13-19 digits or fails Luhn check
validation_sequence.notes: RFC rule 3 deliberately reuses the MISSING_FIELD envelope for format failures (not only absent fields).

validation_sequence.name: Expiry not in past
validation_sequence.what_is_validated: card expiry is not before the current month
validation_sequence.constraint: expiryYear > currentYear OR (expiryYear == currentYear AND expiryMonth >= currentMonth)
validation_sequence.failure_condition: expiryYear < currentYear OR (expiryYear == currentYear AND expiryMonth < currentMonth)

validation_sequence.name: Fingerprint uniqueness
validation_sequence.what_is_validated: no existing card with the same (customer_id, fingerprint)
validation_sequence.failure_condition: a row with the same (customer_id, fingerprint) already exists
validation_sequence.notes: Fingerprint is computed by business_logic BL-001 before this check.

validation_sequence.name: Vault tokenisation
validation_sequence.what_is_validated: vault-service returns a token for the card
validation_sequence.failure_condition: vault call fails or times out (5000 ms, 1 retry) → 503, no DB write
validation_sequence.notes: No DB write occurs before vault responds (guards against partial state).

validation_sequence.name: Persist card
validation_sequence.failure_condition: DB unavailable → 503 (RFC states 503 if DB down but names no error code/body)
validation_sequence.notes: On success the endpoint returns HTTP 200 {token}.

responses.condition: Missing required field or invalid card format
Card expiry is in the past
Card fingerprint already exists for this customer
Feature flag payment.card_save.enabled disabled (no response body specified)

rest.sla: p95 latency <= 300 ms under normal load on staging

business_logic.rule: Compute SHA-256 fingerprint of {customerId}:{cardNumber}; used by the step-5 uniqueness check.
Raw cardNumber and cvv must never be written to application logs at any level (DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR).

user_flows.name: Save card (happy path)
user_flows.trigger: Client POSTs a valid, non-duplicate card while payment.card_save.enabled is on

steps.action: wallet-service -> DB: SELECT fingerprint WHERE customer_id + fingerprint (dedup check)

user_flows.outcome: Card fingerprinted, tokenised via vault-service, persisted in payment_cards; 200 {token} returned

user_flows.name: Duplicate card rejected
user_flows.trigger: Client POSTs a card whose (customer_id, fingerprint) already exists

steps.action: wallet-service -> DB: dedup check finds an existing row for (customer_id, fingerprint)
Reject with DUPLICATE_CARD (see error_codes); no INSERT, no tokenise

user_flows.name: Vault tokenise timeout
user_flows.trigger: vault-service does not respond within the tokenise timeout

steps.action: Roll back the save; return upstream error

user_flows.outcome: No card persisted; error surfaced to client (see cross_service_dependencies for timeout/retry)

cross_service_dependencies.failure_behavior: 409 on unique-constraint violation (dedup); 503 if DB down

service_level_changes.change: New DB table payment_cards (migration V001__create_payment_cards.sql, additive)

feature_flags.name: payment.card_save.enabled
feature_flags.on_behavior: Endpoint live; cards saved and tokenised
feature_flags.rollout: OFF in production until M1 sign-off

risk_areas.mitigation: Log scrubbing rule enforced in CI (REQ-005 / AC-006)

risk_areas.risk: Vault service timeout causes partial state
risk_areas.mitigation: No DB write before vault responds; 503 returned on timeout

risk_areas.risk: Concurrent duplicate saves bypass DB check
risk_areas.mitigation: DB unique constraint is the final guard; tested with a concurrent integration test
Additive migration only; rollback drops the table

sla_nfr_targets.target: p95 latency <= 300 ms under normal load on staging
vault-service call timeout 5000 ms with 1 retry, then 503

extraction_gaps.detail: RFC states no dates/sprints for M1 or M2 delivery (PRD mentions 'current sprint' but the RFC itself does not).
Feature-flag-disabled 404 has no response body specified; captured as an unnamed response.
RFC says DB-down returns 503 but names no error code or body for that case (only vault's SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is defined).

open_questions.question: RFC says DB-down returns HTTP 503 but does not state whether it reuses the SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE code/body (defined for vault) or a distinct one — needs author confirmation.

prd_drift_flags.detail: RFC reuses MISSING_FIELD (400) for invalid card *format* (Luhn/length) failures, not just absent fields. PRD AC-002 specifies MISSING_FIELD only for an omitted field, so a present-but-malformed cardNumber has no PRD-defined error contract.
